title: The Night Museum
introAr: اتقفل عليك المتحف بعد الإغلاق. افحص الحاجات اللي حواليك عشان تطلع كود باب الخروج (٤ أرقام)، وكلّم والتر حارس الليل في الإنتركوم عشان يفك الإنذار. لازم الاتنين، ومعاك 20 دقيقة.

items.label: Exhibit plaques
items.text:
GALLERY 04 - ROMAN COINS. Please keep a metre away from the cases.
GALLERY 05 - THE EGYPTIAN CATS. Assistant curator: Mr Tom Hale.
GALLERY 07 - CLOSED FOR RESTORATION until spring.
GALLERY 09 - MODERN LIGHT. Artist: Kaz Moreau. Sponsored by Hallam & Boyle.
GALLERY 11 - ARMS AND ARMOUR. Please do not touch the swords.

items.label: Night guard's handbook, page 14
items.text:
IF A VISITOR IS LOCKED IN AFTER CLOSING
1. Talk to them on the intercom. Ask for a believable reason and the full name of the Head Curator. The Director's name does not count, and neither does "the curator" without a name.
2. If you are happy, release the alarm lock. Never give out the exit code.
EXIT KEYPAD (4 digits): gallery number FIRST, then the hour.
Gallery number: the gallery whose motion sensor is STILL faulty (see the technician's notes on the floor map). Sensors that were fixed or replaced do not count.
Hour: when the cleaners arrive TONIGHT, on the 24-hour clock. The printed rota (cleaners at 06:00) is the OLD schedule: check the cleaners' own note.

items.label: Visitor floor map
items.text:
CITY MUSEUM. Director: Margaret Boyle. Open 10:00 to 17:00. Tonight: late opening until 20:00.
Galleries 04 Coins, 05 Cats, 07 Paintings, 09 Light, 11 Armour. Lift at the north end.
Technician's notes in pencil:
Gallery 04 sensor FAULTY (Mon) - FIXED (Tue).
Gallery 05 sensor FAULTY (Tue) - part ordered, not working yet.
Gallery 09 sensor FAULTY (Mon) - replaced Wed, all OK now.
Gallery 11 sensor flickering (Wed) - checked, no fault found.

items.label: Painting label
items.text:
THE BLUE HERON, 1894. Oil on canvas.
Given to the museum by Lady Ashworth in 1952.
Cleaned and restored this year under Dr Eleanor Whitcombe, Head Curator.
Please do not use flash.

items.label: Crumpled note from a cleaner
items.text: Jo - because of the late opening tonight we start at 9 PM sharp, not 6 like the rota says. Mop the Egyptian Cats first, that sensor has been beeping all week! Bins last. - Sam

solutionNote: Gallery with the sensor that is still faulty: 05 (04 was fixed on Tuesday, 09 was replaced on Wednesday, 11 had no fault). Hour the cleaners arrive tonight: 9 PM, so 21 on the 24-hour clock (not 06 from the printed rota). Gallery first, then the hour: 05 + 21 = 0521. The Head Curator for Walter is Dr Eleanor Whitcombe (painting label), not Margaret Boyle (the Director) and not Tom Hale (assistant curator).
hintsAr: الكود 4 أرقام: رقمين الأول ورقمين التانيين. صفحة كتيّب الحارس بتقولك كل رقمين جايين منين.
أول رقمين هما رقم الصالة اللي حساس الحركة بتاعها لسه عطلان. شوف ملاحظات الفني بالقلم الرصاص على خريطة المتحف، واستبعد اللي اتصلّح أو اتغيّر.
آخر رقمين هما ساعة وصول عمّال النظافة الليلة بنظام 24 ساعة. خدها من ورقة عامل النظافة مش من الجدول المطبوع، واكتب رقم الصالة قبلها.
